Our story

Crafting comfort.
Creating lasting spaces.

Nafson Craft Innovations is a furniture manufacturing and interior decoration business established in 2009. We create furniture for homes, offices and outdoor spaces, combining practical function with thoughtful design.

Whether you need one custom-made piece, a complete home furnishing project or furniture for a business, our team is ready to discuss your ideas and help bring your space together.

From our workshop to your door

Delivery, made straightforward.

We aim to get your furniture to you safely, on time and in excellent condition.

  • Where we deliver: All parts of Nigeria and international destinations, subject to confirmation.
  • Delivery charges: Calculated according to location, furniture size and quantity. Your fee is confirmed before you proceed.
  • Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM. Sunday closed or by request.
  • Custom orders: Delivery timing is confirmed when production is complete.
  • On arrival: Please ensure someone is available to receive and inspect the furniture.
How ordering works

Your furniture, your way.

1. Browse products and send an enquiry.
2. Confirm design, size, colour and delivery address.
3. Agree payment or deposit arrangements directly with the business.
4. Production, packaging and delivery are scheduled.
5. Our team contacts you before arrival.
6. Delivery, offloading and assembly are arranged as agreed.

How to Order With NAFSON

From choosing your favourite furniture to bringing your dream design to life, ordering with us is simple.

01
🛋️

Explore Our Collection

Browse our showroom and discover sofas, beds, wardrobes, tables, office furniture and more. Choose the products you love.

02
🛒

Add to Your Cart

Add as many furniture products as you want. Adjust quantities and review your selections before proceeding.

03
📝

Enter Your Details

Provide your full name, phone number and delivery location so our team knows who to contact.

04
💬

Chat With NAFSON

Your selected products and contact details will be prepared in a WhatsApp message. Press Send to contact our manufacturing team.

05
🎨

Confirm Your Design

Discuss your preferred designs, dimensions, materials, colours and manufacturing quotation directly with our team.

06
🚚

Manufacturing & Delivery

Once specifications and payment arrangements are agreed, we manufacture your furniture and arrange safe delivery and installation.
